_comment: Difficulty targets for the balance sim (tools/balance_sim.gd, BalanceCurve). Each case plays runs auto-fights of a freshly drafted squad (BotFactory, run i drafts from seed base_seed + i) against one act's enemies and checks the win rate against target [low, high] percent. factions: the factions of the act (data/combat/factions.json, by_act), run i fights factions[i % size]; empty plays the generic roster (enemy_tables.json pools), as the boss stub does. tier: the act's tier for the defense level (tier_by_act), raised tier_steps tiers (capped at the top tier): early fights are alert 0 (0 steps), late fights the act's top alert. territory (default: act) picks the difficulty-curve scaling (DifficultyRules; boss is the boss stub's territory). skill_ranks_added: ranks added to every squad skill, a stand-in for the growth a squad has by that act.
